stories.title: Wholesale inflation peaks at 11.4% in September as fuel, food prices surge
stories.summary: India's wholesale price inflation rose to 11.4% in September, the highest level recorded in the series, driven by higher fuel and food prices. The headline reported the increase as a series high.
stories.why: Rising wholesale inflation can affect downstream consumer prices and inform monetary‑policy decisions.

stories.title: Zetwerk secures Rs 2,251 crore anchor bid; BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, Nomura among investors; IPO opens Oct 15
stories.summary: Zetwerk, the Indian manufacturing platform, attracted anchor investors that include BlackRock, Goldman Sachs and Nomura, together committing Rs 2,251 crore. The anchor bidding forms part of the company’s upcoming initial public offering. The IPO is scheduled to open to the public on 15 October.
stories.why: The offering signals strong institutional backing for a major new listing on Indian exchanges, which could influence market sentiment and capital allocation.

stories.title: Apate sends AI agents undercover to get scammed so they can gather fraud intelligence
stories.summary: The company says its fleet of agents has so far wasted 17 years of scammers’ time across 2.5 million conversations. The FBI received more than 22,000 complaints of AI-related crimes in 2025, which resulted in about $893 million in losses.
stories.why: This matters because it could change AI capabilities, costs, adoption, regulation or competitive positioning.

stories.title: US inflation exceeds expectations in year to September
stories.summary: Official data show that US inflation rose more than forecasters predicted for the 12‑month period ending September. The increase was driven by higher petrol prices, which climbed after Middle East energy supplies were disrupted by the US‑Israel conflict with Iran. The release comes ahead of next month’s midterm elections, which are being fought over cost‑of‑living pressures across the United States.
stories.why: The higher‑than‑expected inflation adds to the cost‑of‑living pressures that are central to the upcoming midterm elections.

stories.title: YouTube Music launches new labels as AI-generated music floods streaming platforms
stories.summary: YouTube said it collaborated with various music partners and deployed its own detection tools to identify AI-generated music. The move comes as AI-generated music rapidly expands across streaming services, and many platforms are adopting their own approaches.For instance, Apple Music has plans to introduce “Made With AI” labels as part of its AI Transparency Tags later this year.
stories.why: This matters because it could change AI capabilities, costs, adoption, regulation or competitive positioning.

stories.title: Starlink restrictions in Ukraine war linked to political situation, Zelensky aide says
stories.summary: New restrictions on the speed at which some of Ukraine's weapons can travel and stay connected to the Starlink internet network have disrupted Ukraine's battlefield "missions", President Volodymyr Zelensky's adviser has warned. Beskrestnov said SpaceX's move "cannot be a coincidence and is related to the current political situation".
stories.why: This matters because it could affect economic conditions, trade, technology, public systems or international decisions.

stories.title: India’s wholesale price index rises to 11.39% in September
stories.summary: India’s wholesale price index (WPI) rose to 11.39% year‑on‑year in September, up from 9.9% in August, as higher fuel and food prices pushed the index higher. Retail inflation also climbed to 5.54% in September, driven mainly by vegetable price increases. The increase reflects pressure from global commodity costs and domestic weather‑related risks such as uneven monsoon rainfall.
stories.why: The rise heightens concerns about food inflation amid global commodity price pressures and weather‑related supply risks.
